title: Software Engineer
content: <p>We build scheduling tools for event organisers across Europe. You will design, build and run TypeScript services and React interfaces, integrate third-party APIs, and own features from idea to production. You have shipped production software, write tests by habit, and use AI coding tools with judgement. We offer a small team, real ownership and a calm pace.</p><h3>Requirements</h3><ul><li>Experience with TypeScript and React</li><li>Comfortable with real-time sync</li></ul>
